Sizing & Samples

Available in Youth sizes (5-6, 7-8, 9-11, 12-14) and Adult sizes (S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL). Sample sizes are on display at Lindsay Road N.S. during training sessions.

📍

Collection at Training

Orders are prepared and handed out directly at your next class session at either Lindsay Road N.S. or Citywest. Simply mention your order name to David or Alonzo.

🔒

Secure Stripe Checkout

All orders are processed through Stripe with end-to-end 256-bit encryption. Instant receipt sent directly to your email with support for Apple Pay, Google Pay, and major cards.

Questions about sizing or bulk squad orders? Reach out directly to club secretary David Moloney via WhatsApp or Email.
